Building metrics from an archived panel

Source: vignettes/build-from-archive.Rmd
build-from-archive.Rmd

npcompete can build every metric for any set of years from a local archive: a panel of Form 990 and 990-EZ filers stored as Parquet files, one folder per tax year. The archive is built once from the NCCS SOI panel sample frame (about 2 GB as CSV, 7 million organization-years). After that, a build only reads the years it needs.

This article walks through the steps on a small stand-in for the full panel: the Vermont 501(c)(3) filers in npo_panel_sample (2015-2019), written out in the SOI panel layout. With the real file, the steps and function calls are the same, but builds take minutes instead of seconds.

The archive needs the arrow and data.table packages.

library( npcompete )

1. Set where the archive lives

The archive should live outside the package and outside any synced folder that might hold files online only. Point npcompete at it once per session, or set the NPCOMPETE_ARCHIVE environment variable in .Renviron.

options( npcompete.archive_dir = "D:/data/npcompete-archive" )

Here we use a temporary folder.

arch <- file.path( tempdir(), "npcompete-archive" )
options( npcompete.archive_dir = arch )

2. Build the archive

npc_build_archive() reads the SOI panel CSV, maps its columns to the package’s standard layout with npc_standardize(), and writes one Parquet file per tax year. With the full panel you would run:

npc_build_archive( "SOI-PANEL-SAMPLE-FRAME-COLUMNS-AUGMENTED-W-POP.CSV" )

npo_panel_sample lacks a few columns of the full panel (source file, e-file flag, fiscal year end, revocation dates), so for this example we add them before writing the CSV.

soi <- npo_panel_sample
soi$SOURCE  <- ifelse( is.na( soi$TOTREV ), "", paste0( "SOI_", soi$TAXYEAR + 1, "_PC" ) )
soi$EFILE_X <- "EFILE"
soi$revocation_date <- ""
soi$exemption_reinstatement_date <- ""
soi$TOTLIA  <- NA
soi$REVINVE <- NA
soi$FISYEAR <- soi$TAXYEAR
soi$FISMO   <- 12

csv <- file.path( tempdir(), "soi-panel-vermont.csv" )
data.table::fwrite( soi, csv )

npc_build_archive( csv, overwrite = TRUE )
#> Reading soi-panel-vermont.csv ...
#> Standardizing 9,165 rows ...
#> Writing Parquet dataset to C:\Users\jlecy\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpOcTw4M/npcompete-archive/filers ...
#> Done: 9,133 rows, years 2015-2019.

The archive records what it holds. npc_archive_info() returns the build manifest and the rows per tax year, with a flag for years that look incomplete. In the full panel, the most recent tax year is always partial, because many organizations have not yet filed. npc_build_metrics() drops flagged years unless you ask it not to.

info <- npc_archive_info()
info$year_counts
#>   YEAR    N SHARE_OF_MEDIAN INCOMPLETE
#> 1 2015 1801           0.987      FALSE
#> 2 2016 1812           0.993      FALSE
#> 3 2017 1825           1.000      FALSE
#> 4 2018 1847           1.012      FALSE
#> 5 2019 1848           1.013      FALSE

Each organization appears once per tax year. Where the source panel repeats an organization within a year (a short-period return after a change of accounting period, or the same return in two extracts), npc_standardize() keeps one filing: the latest extract, then the latest period end.

3. Read organizations for some years

npc_get_orgs() reads only the requested years. It keeps 501(c)(3) organizations by default (subsection = 3). It also adds CBSA_FIPS from the county-to-CBSA crosswalk (2023 delineation), so every year uses the same metro boundaries.

orgs <- npc_get_orgs( 2018:2019 )
dim( orgs )
#> [1] 3695   26
head( orgs[ c( "EIN2", "YEAR", "COUNTY_FIPS", "CBSA_FIPS", "NTEEV2",
               "FILER_TYPE", "TOTREV" ) ] )
#>             EIN2 YEAR COUNTY_FIPS CBSA_FIPS     NTEEV2 FILER_TYPE  TOTREV
#> 1 EIN-01-0180687 2018       50027     30150 PSB-S30-RG        990   99714
#> 2 EIN-01-0180687 2019       50027     30150 PSB-S30-RG        990  920705
#> 3 EIN-01-0471151 2018       50023     12740 ENV-C40-RG        990 7980411
#> 4 EIN-01-0471151 2019       50023     12740 ENV-C40-RG        990 7861211
#> 5 EIN-01-0477533 2018       50023     12740 HEL-G32-RG        990  154658
#> 6 EIN-01-0477533 2019       50023     12740 HEL-G32-RG        990  160157

Rows marked IMPUTED fill a gap year between two filings: the organization existed but did not file that year. They count toward organization counts but carry no financial data. Drop them with include_imputed = FALSE.

4. Build metrics

npc_build_metrics() reads the years, attaches market populations from pop_county and pop_cbsa, and computes each requested metric for each market (CBSA or county), subsector (NTEE major group) and year. It also reports SUB = "ALL" and GEO = "ALL" rollups. npc_metrics() lists every metric.

npc_metrics()[ c( "id", "family", "by_resource" ) ]
#>                        id      family by_resource
#> 1        DENSITY_PER_100K       count       FALSE
#> 2          DENSITY_PCTL_N       scale       FALSE
#> 3              MEDIAN_AGE         age       FALSE
#> 4        GRASSROOTS_SHARE  grassroots       FALSE
#> 5  SMALL_DENSITY_PER_100K        size        TRUE
#> 6  LARGE_DENSITY_PER_100K        size        TRUE
#> 7             SMALL_SHARE        size        TRUE
#> 8             LARGE_SHARE        size        TRUE
#> 9          DENSITY_PCTL_R       scale        TRUE
#> 10                    HHI         hhi        TRUE
#> 11                   NHHI         hhi        TRUE
#> 12                    CR1          cr        TRUE
#> 13                    CR2          cr        TRUE
#> 14                    CR3          cr        TRUE
#> 15                    CR4          cr        TRUE
#> 16                    CR5          cr        TRUE
#> 17                    CR6          cr        TRUE
#> 18                    CR7          cr        TRUE
#> 19                    CR8          cr        TRUE
#> 20                  KWOKA       kwoka        TRUE
#> 21                   GINI        gini        TRUE
#> 22       COMMERCIAL_SHARE  commercial       FALSE
#> 23  PROGRAM_REVENUE_SHARE  commercial       FALSE
#> 24       FUNDRAISER_SHARE fundraising       FALSE

#> 27              EXIT_RATE    dynamics       FALSE
#> 28             NET_GROWTH    dynamics       FALSE
#> 29             CHURN_RATE    dynamics       FALSE
#> 30        GRADUATION_RATE    dynamics       FALSE

The default output is one long table, with one row per market, subsector, year, resource and metric:

m <- npc_build_metrics( 2016:2019, geo = "county",
                        resources = c( "TOTREV", "NETASS" ),
                        metrics = c( "HHI", "CR4", "GINI", "DENSITY_PER_100K",
                                     "DENSITY_PCTL_N" ) )
#> Reading 4 year(s) from the archive ...
#> Building county metrics for TOTREV ...
#> Building county metrics for NETASS ...
vt <- substr( m$GEO, 1, 2 ) == "50"     # every US county is in the frame; show Vermont
head( m[ vt, ] )
#> # A tibble: 6 × 8
#>   GEO_LEVEL GEO   SUB    YEAR UNIVERSE RESOURCE METRIC                VALUE
#>   <chr>     <chr> <chr> <dbl> <chr>    <chr>    <chr>                 <dbl>
#> 1 county    50001 ALL    2016 filers   NA       N                      122 
#> 2 county    50001 ALL    2016 filers   NA       POP                  37146.
#> 3 county    50001 ALL    2016 filers   TOTREV   N_RES                  118 
#> 4 county    50001 ALL    2016 filers   TOTREV   RESOURCE_TOTAL   582431292 
#> 5 county    50001 ALL    2016 filers   NA       DENSITY_PER_100K       328.
#> 6 county    50001 ALL    2016 filers   NA       DENSITY_PCTL_N           2

Metrics that do not depend on a resource, such as density, appear once with RESOURCE = NA.

Here is concentration of revenue in Chittenden County (Burlington) across all subsectors:

subset( m, GEO == "50007" & SUB == "ALL" & METRIC %in% c( "HHI", "CR4" ) &
           RESOURCE == "TOTREV" )
#> # A tibble: 8 × 8
#>   GEO_LEVEL GEO   SUB    YEAR UNIVERSE RESOURCE METRIC VALUE
#>   <chr>     <chr> <chr> <dbl> <chr>    <chr>    <chr>  <dbl>
#> 1 county    50007 ALL    2016 filers   TOTREV   HHI    0.269
#> 2 county    50007 ALL    2016 filers   TOTREV   CR4    0.661
#> 3 county    50007 ALL    2017 filers   TOTREV   HHI    0.267
#> 4 county    50007 ALL    2017 filers   TOTREV   CR4    0.660
#> 5 county    50007 ALL    2018 filers   TOTREV   HHI    0.277
#> 6 county    50007 ALL    2018 filers   TOTREV   CR4    0.679
#> 7 county    50007 ALL    2019 filers   TOTREV   HHI    0.273
#> 8 county    50007 ALL    2019 filers   TOTREV   CR4    0.677

Wide tables

format = "wide" returns one table per geography and resource, with metrics as columns. This is the layout of get_all_metrics() and of the files the dashboard reads.

w <- npc_build_metrics( 2019, geo = "cbsa", resources = "TOTREV",
                        metrics = c( "HHI", "NHHI", "KWOKA", "DENSITY_PCTL_N" ),
                        format = "wide" )
#> Reading 1 year(s) from the archive ...
#> Building cbsa metrics for TOTREV ...
names( w )
#> [1] "cbsa_TOTREV"
t <- w$cbsa_TOTREV
subset( t, SUB == "ALL" & N > 0 )
#> # A tibble: 7 × 11
#>   GEO   SUB    YEAR     N        POP N_RES   TOTREV DENSITY_PCTL_N    HHI   NHHI
#>   <chr> <chr> <dbl> <dbl>      <dbl> <dbl>    <dbl>          <dbl>  <dbl>  <dbl>
#> 1 12740 ALL    2019   258     59780.   251   8.93e8              2 0.128  0.124 
#> 2 13540 ALL    2019   129     37325.   124   4.07e8              2 0.225  0.219 
#> 3 14710 ALL    2019   191     45766.   181   4.94e8              2 0.122  0.117 
#> 4 15540 ALL    2019   491    224132.   480   3.30e9              2 0.239  0.238 
#> 5 30150 ALL    2019   291    220936.   281   6.67e8              2 0.0593 0.0559
#> 6 40860 ALL    2019   125     60679    117   4.66e8              2 0.423  0.418 
#> 7 ALL   ALL    2019  1848 332508258.  1783   7.45e9             NA 0.0556 0.0551
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: KWOKA <dbl>

In this sample DENSITY_PCTL_N sits at its cap of 2 for every Vermont metro. The density model compares each market with every other market in the country, and in this sample only Vermont has any organizations. With the full panel, values spread around 0.

Pooled windows for small markets

Small markets have few organizations, so their metrics jump from year to year. window = 3 pools three years for each reported year:

  • each organization’s financial values are averaged over the years it appears;
  • its location and subsector come from its latest year;
  • population is the three-year average.

Reported years without a full window of data are dropped.

w3 <- npc_build_metrics( 2017:2019, geo = "county", window = 3,
                         metrics = c( "DENSITY_PER_100K", "MEDIAN_AGE" ),
                         format = "wide" )
#> Reading 5 year(s) from the archive ...
#> Building county metrics ...
subset( w3$county, SUB == "ALL" & substr( GEO, 1, 2 ) == "50" & YEAR == 2019 )
#> # A tibble: 14 × 8
#>    GEO   SUB    YEAR     N     POP N_AGE DENSITY_PER_100K MEDIAN_AGE

Writing results with a manifest

With out_dir, the results are written as CSV along with manifest.csv. The manifest records the archive used, the years, metrics, options and package version, so the build can be reproduced or compared with a later one.

out <- file.path( tempdir(), "metrics" )
res <- npc_build_metrics( 2018:2019, geo = "cbsa", resources = "TOTREV",
                          metrics = c( "HHI", "GINI" ), format = "wide",
                          out_dir = out )
#> Reading 2 year(s) from the archive ...
#> Building cbsa metrics for TOTREV ...
#> Wrote results to C:\Users\jlecy\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpOcTw4M/metrics
list.files( out )
#> [1] "manifest.csv"                        
#> [2] "NPCOMPETE-METRICS-BY-CBSA-TOTREV.CSV"
head( attr( res, "manifest" ), 12 )
#>                 key
#> 1  data_source_file
#> 2        data_built
#> 3          universe
#> 4            source
#> 5             years
#> 6            window
#> 7               geo
#> 8         resources
#> 9           metrics
#> 10       subsection
#> 11  include_imputed
#> 12 exclude_churches
#>                                                                 value
#> 1  C:/Users/jlecy/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpOcTw4M/soi-panel-vermont.csv
#> 2                                                 2026-11-25 00:41:16
#> 3                                                              filers
#> 4                                                             archive
#> 5                                                           2018,2019
#> 6                                                                   1
#> 7                                                                cbsa
#> 8                                                              TOTREV
#> 9                                                            HHI,GINI
#> 10                                                                  3
#> 11                                                               TRUE
#> 12                                                              FALSE

Choices that change the results

  • cbsa: "crosswalk" (default) assigns CBSAs from each county under the 2023 delineation, the same boundaries as the population data. "geocode" uses the CBSA assigned when the address was geocoded, which reproduces tables built before this option existed.
  • subsection: 501(c)(3) only by default; NULL keeps every subsection.
  • density_model: the count model behind DENSITY_PCTL_N, negative binomial by default (see vignette("density")).
  • drop_incomplete_years: keep partial years only when you know why you want them.

To build the same metrics without the SOI panel, from public NCCS files, see vignette("build-from-nccs").
